facts.headline: Guided 90 Minute Paddle Tour
facts.description: Embark on a memorable guided kayak tour under the iconic Coronado Bridge in San Diego Bay.
facts.detailsText: Frequently asked questions Q: Is Kayaking safe for beginners? A: Absolutely, your safety is our top priority. There will be 1-2 guides that will accompany you on your tour. In addition, you will have a personal flotation device. We paddle on flat water and will review conditions prior to leaving the dock Q: Do I need to be a strong swimmer? A: While being physically fit and a good swimmer can help, it is not a requirement. If you have concerns about your ability to swim, please let your guide know ahead of time Q: Are there age restrictions? A: Paddler's under the age of 18 are required to have a parent / guardian accompany them. Guests under 14 years old must ride on a tandem kayak with a parent / guardian. Q: What's included with the tour? A: We provide all of the equipment for your tour. Each participant will be provided with a kayak , a paddle, and a personal flotation device Q: Will I get wet? A: Maybe. Depending on your balance, athletic ability and weather conditions it's not uncommon for beginners to fall in Q: How long is the tour? A: The tour lasts approximately 90 minutes with over 60 of those minutes spent on the water. Every participant is different so those times can fluctuate some Q: How far in advance do I need to book? A: In order to secure your place on a tour, we recommend booking well in advance. However reservations can be made as little as the day before Q: Where do the tours take place? A: Our tours take place in Glorietta Bay which is some of the calmest water in all of San Diego Bay. Tours meet at the dock for Seaforth located at 1715 Stand Way Coronado CA 92118 Q: What do I wear? A: We recommend that you wear something that can get wet and that isn't too loose. Athletic wear, sun protective wear or swimsuits are acceptable. Q: Is there a place to change? A: Yes, we have a small changing room in the office Q: Is there somewhere I can store belongings? A: Yes, we have some small locker space for you to store personal belongings Q: Can I bring my cell phone? A: You can but know that is at your own choice and there is a high chance it will get wet, especially if you're a beginner. Our guides will carry a phone and can take pictures for you Guided 90 Minute Paddle Tour Guided 90 Minute Paddle Tour
